sourceText: Fix the ~17 min redundant DONE-validation re-run (and the autopilot_review_submit --deriveBindings hard-throw) that B-3783 hit: a main-merge makes the merge-lineage classifier flag the story's own content-unchanged files as untrusted-lineage-path. The user required a cross-host (Claude CLI + Agy CLI) audit of the written proposal before development; both returned SOUND-WITH-CHANGES and the audit expanded scope to both classifier copies plus -z/maxBuffer/empty-trust/split-catch.
normalizedOutcome: Across a main-merge with content unchanged, DONE validation reuse is granted (existingEvidenceBasis fresh) and autopilot_review_submit --deriveBindings succeeds, on BOTH the reuse and admissibility copies; a genuinely content-changed non-metadata file still refuses reuse.
acceptanceClaim: classifyTrustedValidationLineage and the admissibility path return trusted (reuse allowed) when a merge re-introduces content-unchanged story files, and return rejected untrusted-lineage-path when a non-metadata file's content genuinely differs between evidenceHead and currentHead.
